name: Leeds Beckett University

sources.title: Credibility interviews – points to consider (Leeds Beckett University PDF)
topics: Reasons for choosing Leeds Beckett University
Funding your study in the UK
Other things to think about (gap in study, career path)
quotes: Why did you choose Leeds Beckett University over other universities?
What research did you do into Leeds Beckett University? For example, did you research our facilities, campuses, accommodation etc?
How will your choice of Leeds Beckett University benefit you in your chosen subject?
Why did you choose study in the UK rather than in your home country?
Why did you choose study in the UK over study in another English-speaking country?
Benefits of this course for your chosen career path
Your prior interest in this subject – are you a member of a professional body associated with this area for example?
Any previous study you have already undertaken in this subject area
How you plan to use what you will learn on your chosen course when you return to your home country.

Think about how you will intend to fund yourself during your studies in the UK. How will you get your funds? If your parents are funding you then think about where their funds are coming from, and how they will afford this.

If you will be staying off campus think about how you intend to travel in to the University – can you afford to pay for frequent bus travel for example? Research into how far your intended accommodation is from campus and how much this may cost you.
Think about any other costs that might be involved in studying in the UK (books, travel, food, hobbies etc)

If you have a gap in study be prepared to explain what you have been doing during the time since you were last in education (e.g. working). Think about how this gap will benefit you in your intended study.
Think about your intended career path and how your chosen subject will benefit it in the future.
sources.notes: PDF downloaded by WebFetch and text extracted locally (pypdf). Written as 'points to consider' for the UKVI credibility interview; items are phrased partly as questions and partly as prompts. Also notes International Foundation / Pre-sessional applicants should think about the course they progress to.
